name: McDaniel College Budapest
description: McDaniel College Budapest, founded in 1994, stands as a fully accredited American college nestled in the heart of Europe. Born from the visionary aspirations of McDaniel College alumnus George Varga, the Budapest campus embodies a commitment to enriching Hungary's higher education landscape with a liberal arts presence. Over the years, the institution has evolved, now offering a comprehensive four-year Bachelor's Degree program, aiming to deliver the pinnacle of U.S. higher learning amidst the dynamic international setting of Budapest.
